_comment_temp: 'CPU Package' is the on-die DTS - the standard CPU temperature, and what HWMonitor calls Package. It is spiky. 'Core Average' is smoother; the ITE 'Temperature #N' sensors are board probes and are what Gigabyte Control Center shows.
_comment_fan: Fan #1 = CPU header (GCC 'CPU'), #2/#3 = System 1 and 2 (empty), #4 = System 3, #5 = CPU_OPT which on this build is the PUMP.
